title: Take a Minott | KEY.co
description_expanded: Venture upstairs to discover two additional inviting bedrooms, with one showcasing a majestic King bed and the other equipped with two sets of cozy bunks, comfortably accommodating four. A well-appointed full bath with a tub/shower combo further enhances this level. The basement unveils a relaxed living area, creating the perfect hideaway for youngsters. However, the true essence of this home is its captivating outdoor oasis. The 18x36 heated pool becomes the heart of relaxation, surrounded by a vast patio that promises endless moments of leisure, be it casual alfresco dining or sun-soaked lounging. For the tech-savvy, the home is equipped with central air conditioning, swift Wi-Fi, and a cable/smart TV, ensuring entertainment and comfort at every turn. Experience this slice of paradise where every detail is curated to perfection. A plush counter seating for four and an adjacent dining table for eight ensure that everyone can dine in style. The main floor graciously hosts a spacious primary suite adorned with a King bed, a luxurious private bath, and an expansive walk-in closet. For added convenience, the washer/dryer is strategically placed on this level, and a chic powder room brings a touch of sophistication. As summer beckons, the three-season room emerges as the favorite spot. Accessible off the dining room and leading to the pool, its vaulted ceiling with skylights not only invites ample sunlight but also offers a shaded sanctuary during sun-drenched afternoons.
